name: Claude Developer Foundations

exam.format: 53 multiple-choice and multiple-response items in 120 minutes, proctored online or at a Pearson VUE test center. 12-month validity; on-time renewal is a free, non-proctored assessment.

scope: Agents / workflows; Application integration; Claude Code; Evaluation / debugging; Model choice / optimization; Prompts / context; Safety; Tools / MCP
requirements: Restricted to Claude Partner Network organizations: registration needs a company email domain recognized on the partner record. A personal Claude subscription is not enough.
ai_policy: The reviewed Claude certification rules prohibit AI assistance during the closed-book exam.
caveats: Retakes need a wait of 14, 30 and then 90 days after each failed attempt, with at most four attempts in 12 months; each attempt pays the fee.
